typesense:explore.greeting:
Welcome to the Civilization.

Humanity lives within a colossal city divided into ten official tiers, each representing a different level of wealth, status, and power. Exactly 9,999,999,999 people inhabit them, from the nine billion struggling to survive in Tier One to the nine rulers of Tier Ten, known as The Nine. Each tier becomes smaller and more powerful as you rise.

The Nine collectively control the entire civilization, while Tiers Nine through Six serve as layers of officials and administrators beneath them. Tiers Five through One contain the vast majority of ordinary citizens, with living conditions becoming harsher the lower you go.

But beneath Tier One lies Tier Zero.

An ancient underground world outside the official hierarchy, Tier Zero has no known population count and no conventional government. Criminals, outcasts, fugitives, and entire communities live among its tunnels and ruins. Yet even this lawless world has a ruler: Shi, a mysterious figure whose real name, appearance, and gender are unknown. Shi is feared throughout the entire civilization as one of its greatest threats.

Choose where your story begins:

Tier One — The Bottom: Struggle among nine billion people in poverty, debt, and overcrowding, with an unexpected opportunity potentially offering you a way upward.

Tier Nine — The Inner Circle: Become one of only ninety people who report directly to The Nine, just as a mysterious summons brings you closer to the rulers themselves.

Tier Zero — The Underworld: Enter a lawless world beneath civilization, where factions fight for control and rumors suggest Shi is preparing something.

Where will you begin?
(working on a full bot on hammer. ai, as that gives me more space to work with, but have fun, this took me a long time.)
